data.gender_notes: Hazeem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hazeem is derived from the Arabic root 'h-z-m' which means 'to watch, observe, or be vigilant'. This name is often given to boys due to its spiritual and protective connotations. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is reported to have said that the name Hazeem is a powerful protector against the Evil Eye. The name is also associated with wisdom and knowledge, as a hazeem is someone who is constantly observant and aware of their surroundings.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes protection and vigilance, reminding us to be mindful of our spiritual journey and to guard against negative influences.
data.etymology: Hazeem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vigilant, Watchful, Protective.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazeem total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
